title: Treskowallee, Berlin
description:
Serviced Apartment - A piece of home for a few months? 

Whether you are traveling for work, traveling or just need a nice place to stay for a long time:In our fully and smartly furnished apartments you get high-quality furnishings and individual service. 
The up to 25m2 large modern studios are equipped with a kitchenette, two separate bed with a bed width of 0.90m and a flat screen TV. 
The modern kitchenette is fully equipped: fridge, dishwasher, 2 hobs, microwave and extractor hood: everything is there! So that you can serve yourself something delicious at any time, dishes, glasses, bowls, pots and cooking utensils are included. There is also a table with seating. The rooms are cleaned every week by our staff. 

Laundry Room: Washing machine (fee required), Dryer (fee required)

----
*Uncomplicated CheckIn on the day of arrival*.

1 week before arrival you will receive an email with further information for the day of arrival as well as instructions for using the app and the checkin kiosk.

1)	Do you already use the free app "Hotelbird" for PreCheckIn and room card? 

With the app, you can check in on the day of arrival while on the move. Enter the booking number and last name of the booking and follow the instructions in the app. 

Through the app, you use your phone as a key and can no longer lose it.

For the use of the app you need to activate the Bluetooth function!!

2)	You want to check in on site first?

Our checkin-kiosk is also available around the clock.
Have your booking number and last name of the booking ready and follow the instructions on the screen.

++Please note that you can only create your room card via app or checkin-kiosk after 2 pm.++

We are available for you by phone around the clock. If you would like to speak to a member of staff on site, please refer to the notices at the reception desk in the building.


In the event of non-business stays in the city of Berlin, a visitor's tax of 5% of the net overnight stay will be charged additionally, limited to a contiguous overnight stay of 21 days. 

----
Neighborhood:
The apartment is located in the district Berlin Karlshorst and only 100m from the Karlshorst S-Bahn station. 
The location of your accommodation offers everything your heart desires. In Karlshorst, living in the countryside, work and leisure meet. In idyllic Karlshorst, a district of Berlin-Lichtenberg, you can relax after a long day of work with a trip to the harness racing track or the beautiful beach on the Müggelsee or enjoy the city life after a short drive in the center of Berlin. Cultural interests, recreation from everyday life and an exciting nightlife can be wonderfully combined here.

title: Zwieseler Straße, Berlin
description:
A bright (East and West exposition with big windows) fully furnished townhouse on two floors. It was built and renovated in 2013 in the historic area of Museum Karlshorst. Friendly and international family neighbors.

Great access to public transport and grocery shopping nearby. Zwieseler Straße is located between S-Bahnhof Karlshorst und dem U-Bahnhof Tierpark. In 15 minutes with S-und U-Bahn to the city centre, bus and tram stops nearby as well. 2 big playgrounds and a child friendly environment.

What's around:

-Excellent and safe location for families, two big playgrounds and nature reserve Biesenhorster Sand in walking distance. Wuhleide Park

-The recreation and amusement park of Wuhlheide is just 5 minutes away by car or 10 minutes by bicycle

- Tierpark, the largest zoo in Europe, is also minutes away


Reason for rental offer: year abroad until summer May 2026.

We kindly request that you tell us  how many people wish to stay in the house and a bit about yourself. Thank you and we are looking forward to meeting you!

title: Normannenstraße, Berlin
description:
The apartment is ideal for singles or couples looking for a comfortable and quiet home with fast connections to the city.
With a size of approx. 35 m2, the apartment impresses with its modern furnishings, well-thought-out layout, and bright, light-filled rooms.

Features:
Fully furnished and equipped to a high standard

Spacious living room with sofa, TV, and dining area

Bedroom with a comfortable double bed and wardrobe

Fitted kitchen with all necessary appliances (stove, refrigerator, oven, toaster, electric kettle)

Modern bathroom with shower and bathtub

Washing machine in the apartment

Internet connection included

Fully equipped kitchen:
▫ Oven, toaster, electric kettle
▫ Refrigerator with freezer compartment
▫ Coffee-making options (e.g. coffee machine or French press)
▫ Cutlery, plates & dish towels

✔ Living comfort:
▫ Smart TV & internet included
▫ Washing machine for personal laundry
▫ Drying rack for convenient drying
▫ Trash bins for easy waste disposal

Location:
The property is located in a lively residential area in Berlin Altglienicke (Treptow). Several bus lines operate nearby. In the immediate vicinity, you’ll find restaurants, bakeries, two doctors' offices, two supermarkets, and a café. Parks and green areas, fitness studios, a post office, a flower shop, and a pharmacy are also within easy reach.

title: Ontarioseestraße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished student apartments. 
Our Bronze apartments are fully furnished and perfect for student life. You’ll have a comfy bed, your own private kitchen, an en-suite bathroom, and a dedicated study space with a desk and chair. There’s also a big wardrobe and plenty of storage for all your stuff. Plus, high-speed WiFi and all-inclusive rent mean no surprise bills—just move in and make yourself at home. 
You will also have access to shared spaces like the gym, lounge, study rooms and communal kitchen: all included in your rent. Tierpark is conveniently located – just a 2-minute walk from the U-Bahn, tram and bus stops, close to shops, and just around the corner from the University of Applied Sciences (HTW). Any questions? No problem! Our friendly multilingual operational team at the front desk is always happy to help.

Which services do you have: 
Residence office with Residence Manager/Vending machne like TULU Shop items will complement vending offerings and reflect residents' preferred (local) brands
Free Wifi/Security Service/Barbecue area outside/Bicycle parking/Indoor Gym/LaundrylLounge/Lockers/Communal Areas/Study area/Communal Kitchen for rent
Laundry Room available: 2,80 Euro per wash/dry cycle


**Early termination before the end of the agreed rental period is not possible. An exception is if you have been Ex-matriculated or have finished your studies. This must be proven within 2 weeks.
** *Tenants must vacate the apartment one week before the end of their rental period to allow time for cleaning and maintenance before the next tenant moves in, unless they are extending their stay.
A small pro-rata discount will be automatically applied to the final month's rent and shown on the invoice.

title: Büchnerweg, Berlin
description:
Life at Berlin Adlershof
295 apartments, 295+ students... be one of us & meet extraordinary people. Adlershof is not only a home to renowned non-university research institutions, six institutes of the Humboldt University and around 1,200 companies that are perfect for internships, but also – and this is the best part – our brand new building. Be a part of our community and meet exciting people like you. Our student residence is just a stone’s throw away from the Humboldt University of Berlin – Campus Adlershof. And you’ll find everything else you need for a laid-back student life in the surrounding area as well – from various shopping stores to McDonalds, McFit and Obi, everything is within walking distance.

Our student community offers stylishly designed apartments for those who thrive on the energy of big cities. With us, you have a fully-furnished home complete with high speed wifi, gym, gaming areas, multimedia gaming room, 24-hour laundry, study areas and a very spacious community lobby. There’s also solid access to a diverse network of friends, events, and other amazing opportunities.

Are you looking for a stylish new home base with the perfect combination of hip lifestyle and clear design? This apartment category offers you a personal living experience in a 17sqm space miracle. Our bed with feel-good factor, your own workspace, an additional dining area, sufficient storage throughout the room, a stylish kitchenette with microwave, induction hob, fridge and a modern shower room turn your apartment into an adorable home. 

*Prices may vary depending on floor level, length of stay and rental period.

Included in your All-in rent: 
- Utilities (water, heating, electricity)
- fully furnished Apartment 
- high speed internet up to 1 Gbit/s 
- Community Areas, such as
   - Lobby with on-site staff
   - Laundrette
   - Study areas & Silent room
   - Gaming Areas with Kicker, Billiard, AirHockey, Ping-Pong
   - Gaming room with gaming console
   - Outdoor Areas with Roof Top Terrace
   - Community Kitchen
   - Gym (160sqm)

As well as:
- Bicycle Storage 
- Front Office 
- Cashless-Payment Systems 
- Events 
- CCTV in the whole building for your Security 
- Security Service on Call in the night 

For each contract a security deposit of 1,5 all in rent applies as well as a one-time handling fee of 235 EUR.

Take a relaxed approach to deposit security. We have partnered with Garentii to offer a quick and comfortable solution. For a small fee, you can skip the deposit and save on upfront costs. Ready to say goodbye to deposits? 
IMPORTANT: To complete your booking, you must transfer the deposit or enroll with Garentii deposit insurance. Failing to do so, your application will not be processed.

You want to book directly your preferred apartment or take a look at our other apartment categories? 
Our booking process is fully digital and as comfortable as a hotel booking. 

This is a group advertisement. The photos represent more than one flat and are sample pictures.

-----------------------------------------------

What happens after your booking is completed on HousingAnywhere?

Good to know: After your booking has been confirmed on HousingAnywhere, you have to finalize your reservation in our system. The following steps have to be completed:
1. You will receive a link to our website by e-mail.
2. On our website, you have to select the apartment type you have booked on HousingAnywhere.
3. As the next step, you will receive password-protected access to our app where you can upload your enrollment certificate, as well as a copy of your ID card or passport, and confirm the contract.
4. Afterward, we will check your details, and if everything fits you will receive an automatic e-mail with the payment request of the deposit and our one-off handling fee (this payment differs from the HousingAnywhere booking fee!).
5. As soon as there are no more pending payments (within the next 5 business days) and we have received the money, we will finalize the booking and you will receive a final confirmation e-mail.
6. Please note that the booking through our system should be completed no later than 7 days after booking on HousingAnywhere. After 7 days, the room is no longer reserved for you and can be booked by others. Just before the semester starts, reservations can only be held for 2 days. In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

-----------------------------------------------

What lease terms are available and what is the deal with the 1 week early move out?

Depending on the property, you can choose between apartments with a minimum lease term of 6 to 12 months. However, during this rental period you must always be studying. Please note, the return of your apartment to us is one week before the end of the rental period, in order to be able to carry out cleaning, maintenance and repair measures necessary due to the use of the apartment and for a direct follow-up rental. We have calculated the rent on the basis of an effective term shortened by one week, so that this regulation does not represent an economic disadvantage for you. Of course, if you extend your stay with us and continue to reside in your apartment, no prior move-out is required between your old lease and your new lease.

Adlershof is not only a home to renowned non-university research institutions, six institutes of the Humboldt University and around 1,200 companies that are perfect for internships, but also – and this is the best part – our brand new building. Be a part of our community and meet exciting people like you. Our student residence is just a stone’s throw away from the Humboldt University of Berlin – Campus Adlershof. And you’ll find everything else you need for a laid-back student life in the surrounding area as well – from various shopping stores to McDonalds, McFit and Obi, everything is within walking distance.

Our student community offers stylishly designed apartments for those who thrive on the energy of big cities. With us, you have a fully-furnished home complete with high speed wifi, gym, gaming areas, multimedia gaming room, 24-hour laundry, study areas and a very spacious community lobby. There’s also solid access to a diverse network of friends, events, and other amazing opportunities.

Enjoy the advantages of a room with its own terrace or balcony to hang out with your friends after a long summer day full of studies. On top you get more latitude through more space with this Patio/ Balcony apartment category. On 22sqm it offers your personal living experience in a comfortable space. Our bed with feel-good factor, your own workspace and additional dining area, sufficient storage throughout the room, a stylish kitchenette with microwave, induction hob, fridge and a modern shower room turn your apartment into a small wonderland. 

*Prices may vary depending on floor level, length of stay and rental period.

Included in your All-in rent: 
- Utilities (water, heating, electricity)
- fully furnished Apartment 
- high speed internet up to 1 Gbit/s 
- Community Areas, such as
   - Lobby with on-site staff
   - Laundrette
   - Study areas & Silent room
   - Gaming Areas with Kicker, Billiard, AirHockey, Ping-Pong
   - Gaming room with gaming console
   - Outdoor Areas with Roof Top Terrace
   - Community Kitchen
   - Gym (160sqm)

As well as:
- Bicycle Storage 
- Front Office 
- Cashless-Payment Systems 
- Events 
- CCTV in the whole building for your Security 
- Security Service on Call in the night 

For each contract a security deposit of 1,5 all in rent applies as well as a one-time handling fee of 235 EUR.

Take a relaxed approach to deposit security. We have partnered with Garentii to offer a quick and comfortable solution. For a small fee, you can skip the deposit and save on upfront costs. Ready to say goodbye to deposits? 
IMPORTANT: To complete your booking, you must transfer the deposit or enroll with Garentii deposit insurance. Failing to do so, your application will not be processed.

You want to book directly your preferred apartment or take a look at our other apartment categories? 
Our booking process is fully digital and as comfortable as a hotel booking. 

This is a group advertisement. The photos represent more than one flat and are sample pictures.

-----------------------------------------------

What happens after your booking is completed on HousingAnywhere?

Good to know: After your booking has been confirmed on HousingAnywhere, you have to finalize your reservation in our system. The following steps have to be completed:
1. You will receive a link to our website by e-mail.
2. On our website, you have to select the apartment type you have booked on HousingAnywhere.
3. As the next step, you will receive password-protected access to our app where you can upload your enrollment certificate, as well as a copy of your ID card or passport, and confirm the contract.
4. Afterward, we will check your details, and if everything fits you will receive an automatic e-mail with the payment request of the deposit and our one-off handling fee (this payment differs from the HousingAnywhere booking fee!).
5. As soon as there are no more pending payments (within the next 5 business days) and we have received the money, we will finalize the booking and you will receive a final confirmation e-mail.
6. Please note that the booking through our system should be completed no later than 7 days after booking on HousingAnywhere. After 7 days, the room is no longer reserved for you and can be booked by others. Just before the semester starts, reservations can only be held for 2 days. In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

-----------------------------------------------

What lease terms are available and what is the deal with the 1 week early move out?

Depending on the property, you can choose between apartments with a minimum lease term of 6 to 12 months. However, during this rental period you must always be studying. Please note, the return of your apartment to us is one week before the end of the rental period, in order to be able to carry out cleaning, maintenance and repair measures necessary due to the use of the apartment and for a direct follow-up rental. We have calculated the rent on the basis of an effective term shortened by one week, so that this regulation does not represent an economic disadvantage for you. Of course, if you extend your stay with us and continue to reside in your apartment, no prior move-out is required between your old lease and your new lease.

Neighborhood information
Treptow-Köpenick
In one word: Green
Closest Metro: Treptower Park (S8, S9, S41, S42, S85), Köpenick (S3), Plänterwald (S8, S9, S45, S46, S85), Schöneweide (S8, S9, S42, S45-47, S85, RB, RB24), and Adlershof (S8, S9, S45, S46, S85)
Move here to be near: Treptower Park, old town Köpenick, Köpenick Palace, Müggelsee, Molecule Man, and Stadion An der Alten Försterei (the home to FC Union Berlin)

Overview
Treptow-Köpenick is Berlin's largest and least densely populated district. The beautiful forests, lakes, and affordable cost of living make this area popular with families and native East Germans. It is ideal for anyone looking for something more tranquil and picturesque, but still well-connected to downtown.

What can I do here?
When you aren't exploring the lakes and forests, catch an FC Union Berlin game, or visit the more than 140 shops at The Forum shopping center on Bahnhofstrasse. For a night out, see a show at Stadttheater Cöpenick, an old German theater that opened in 1889. Gasthaus Zenner offers old-school German cuisine, and Freiheit 15 is a cool riverside event space with a restaurant and beer garden.

Fascinating fact
Three-(hidden) of Treptow-Köpenick is either water, woods, or parks, and it is often called the "green lungs of Berlin".

title: Goethestraße, Berlin
description:
Diese gemütliche und ruhige 2-Zimmer Wohnung wirkt durch das Schaffen von unterschiedlichen Wohnbereichen viel geräumiger als man bei 51 qm denken könnte. Das Wohnzimmer und Schlafzimmer bieten alles, was man braucht für ein Zuhause auf Zeit.

Das Bad ist mit einem WC, Waschbecken und einer Dusche ausgestattet.
Die Wohnung wurde charmant eingerichtet und bietet zusätzlich einen Balkon.

Die Lage in Oberschöneweide (Köpenick) spricht für sich - ein sehr sympathischer und authentischer Kiez, wenige Straßenzüge von der Spree entfernt.

Mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln unweit der S-Bahn S8, S9, S45, S46 Schöneweide  in sehr guter, zentraler Lage.

In der Nähe befinden sich viele Grünanlagen und Parks. Einkäufe lassen sich hervorragend bei lokalen Supermärkten und Wochenendmärkten erledigen.

Ebenso befinden sich Kioske oder Baumärkte in nur wenigen Minuten erreichbar.

Die Wohngegend bietet viele gemütliche Bars und Cafès in berlinerischer Atmosphäre. Im Sommer bieten sich außerdem viele Gelegenheiten zum Spazieren in den umliegenden Grünflächen sowie entlang des Wassers an der Spree.

Die Wohngegend bietet viele gemütliche Bars und Cafès in berlinerischer Atmosphäre. Im Sommer bieten sich außerdem viele Gelegenheiten zum Spazieren in den umliegenden Grünflächen sowie entlang des Wassers an der Spree.

description:
Die wunderschön geschnittene 3-Zimmer-Wohnung lädt zum Verweilen ein. Das große Wohnzimmer gekoppelt mit Esszimmer bietet Platz für mehrere Personen. Das Schlafzimmer verfügt über ein großes Doppelbett und das Gästezimmer über ein Einzelbett.

Das Badezimmer ist mit einem WC, Waschbecken und einer Badewanne ausgestattet. Die Wohnung wurde charmant eingerichtet und bietet zusätzlich einen Balkon.

Die Lage in Oberschöneweide (Köpenick) spricht für sich – ein sehr sympathischer und authentischer Kiez, wenige Straßenzüge von der Spree entfernt.

title: Pohlestraße, Berlin
description:
This freshly renovated and furnished 2-room flat at Pohlestr. 15 in Köpenick offers a radiant, modern interior and high-quality furnishings for a particularly cosy living experience.
Kitchen / living area:
The open-plan living area is characterised by modern furnishings and a dining area. The chic fitted kitchen completes the cosy ambience of the flat. The attractive floor gives the rooms a special atmosphere. A washing machine with tumble dryer function is also integrated in the kitchenette.
Directly from the kitchen you look out into the quiet garden. The terrace there can also be used by all tenants.

The flat has 2 spacious bedrooms with high-quality box-spring beds, 2 wardrobes and 2 desks and a separate sofa, which can also be used for sleeping.

title: Ostendstraße, Berlin
description:
In Berlin's Schöneweide district stands the innovative and digital student residence on the cutting edge for efficiency houses. The newly developed building complex was designed with six floors and a communal garden, and is located in the immediate vicinity of the University of Applied Sciences.


How is the commute from here to other locations?
Tram lines 27, 60, 61 67 and the nightbus N65 stop, is just a few metres from the building complex.

Does it have parking space?
In the backyard there is a lockable and covered bicycle storage room. There are a plenty of parking spaces in the surrounding area. A parking vignette is not required.

How big is the apartment?
The room has approx. 11.3m2

How many rooms does the apartment have?
This is a 4 room flat with a shared kitchen and shared bathroom. 

Why Choose this apartment?
This room in the 4-person shared flat also has a communal kitchen with a large dining table. Personal rooms can be locked as per convenience.

What's cool about the apartment?
The immediate proximity to the campus for the University of Applied Sciences (HTW). The river Spree with its promenade is about 400m away from the Student apartment. A fitness studio is also located in the immediate vicinity.

Overview
The room can be let out only for students and interns. People doing PhD can also apply.

The flat was developed as a shared apartment concept. The individual rooms in the student residence are rented out with the following amenities:

- Fully furnished
- Bed without blankets or bedspreads.
- Desk, Chair, Lamp
- Closet
- Magnetic bar for documents
- Internet connection
- Fully fitted kitchen without any utensils.. No Utensils are included.
No vacuum cleaner is included.

Washing machine is located in the common area & needs to be used through WeWash app. There will be cost for per wash.
including flat-rate service charges, high-speed internet and a tenant app. The building was equipped with selected digital individual components (parcel station, locking and bell system, consumption meter, etc.)


Amenities & Furniture:
Elevator, Commission Free, Floor heating, Central Heating, New Construction, Shower, Single Bed, Wardrobe, Wardrobe, Fitted kitchen, Refrigerator, Dining Table, Shelf, Working desk, Lamp, Chairs

1) The contract can start on any date, and the rent will be calculated on a daily pro-rata basis.
2) Our contract charges are calculated on a daily pro-rata basis. This means your rent will be based only on the exact number of days from your move-in date.
3) Once the booking is confirmed and all documents are received, we  will send you a rental contract via email and You need to sign it & send it back to me within 48hours.
4) Registration possible and the necessary document will be provided post the move-in
5) The check in can only take place Monday to Friday 9 am until 6 pm. Check in on the weekends or national holidays would be possible upon request for a small fee of 100€
6) Liability insurance is required for your stay and that needs to be submitted to us within 15 days from your move in date.. We recommend you to search for one yourself with a keyword “Haftpflichtversicherung“
7) Final cleaning fee: 200 €
8) 7% Surcharge is applicable for short-lets (duration of less than 6 months)
9) For rental durations of more than six months, the deposit can be paid in three installments.
10) Seurity deposit amount needs to be paid before the move-in date

About Berlin 

Step into Berlin – a pulsating city steeped in history, teeming with creativity, and offering a universe of possibilities. Nestled at the heart of Europe, Berlin extends an irresistible blend of dynamic culture, architectural wonders, and narratives waiting to be unveiled. As you contemplate your upcoming residence in this thriving metropolis, allow us to offer you a tantalizing glimpse into life in Berlin.
Explore a metropolis where antiquity and modernity coalesce seamlessly. From the iconic Brandenburg Gate to the avant-garde structures of Potsdamer Platz, Berlin's architecture narrates tales of its diverse past and the ongoing evolution of its present. Meander through the picturesque cobblestone pathways of Mitte, where galleries, boutiques, and cafés beckon you to immerse yourself in the city's artistic heartbeat.

Berlin's reputation as a cultural haven precedes it. Encompassing world-class museums and galleries like the Pergamon Museum and the East Side Gallery, the city ardently preserves its historical legacy while exulting in its innovative spirit. The medley of culinary delights – from traditional German sausages to pioneering vegan indulgences – mirrors Berlin's ethos of open-mindedness and inclusivity.

Navigating the city is a breeze, thanks to its impeccable connectivity. The efficient public transportation network facilitates exploration of every nook, from the historical allure of Charlottenburg to the edgy charisma of Friedrichshain. Enjoy a leisurely bike ride along the tranquil Spree River or effortlessly traverse neighborhoods via the U-Bahn.

The heart and soul of Berlin resides in its people. The locals, renowned for their warmth and hospitality, welcome newcomers with arms wide open. Engage in spirited dialogues at local beer gardens, partake in community galas within sprawling parks like Tiergarten, and submerge yourself in the city's vibrant nightlife – ranging from intimate jazz enclaves to throbbing techno sanctuaries.

Berlin's allure extends to history buffs, culture aficionados, and seekers of a vibrant lifestyle alike. As you contemplate embracing this city as your own, envisage your role within its narrative – a narrative that champions diversity, innovation, and an unceasing spirit of renaissance. Your voyage in Berlin is on the brink of commencement, and your fresh odyssey promises to be nothing short of extraordinary.

title: Griechische Allee, Berlin
description:
ENGLISH BELOW

ALL-INCLUSIVE | Sonnenterrasse | 2022 kernsaniert | Möbliert & voll ausgestattet | DG-Traum im Altbau

Willkommen über den Dächern der Stadt! Diese lichtdurchflutete 2-Zimmer-Dachgeschosswohnung (ca. 61 sqm) im 4. OG eines gepflegten Altbaus vereint historischen Charme mit modernem Wohnkomfort. Einfach Koffer auspacken und wohlfühlen. Alles ist schon da!

Highlights auf einen Blick

Warmmiete all-inclusive: Nebenkosten, Internet & Strom bereits enthalten
2022 modernisiert: Leitungen, Böden, Bad, Möbel etc.
Sonnenterrasse (Süd-Ausrichtung) mit Weitblick
Komplett möbliert inkl. 160 x 200 cm Bett, Sofa, Arbeitsplatz, Schrank mit viel Stauraum
Einbauküche mit Induktionsfeld, Geschirrspüler & Kühlschrank
Design-Bad mit bodengleicher Regendusche, Marken-Waschmaschine
Großer Einbauschrank im Flur – Garderobe & Stauraum
Fahrradstellplatz im begrünten Innenhof
Top-Lage: ruhige Seitenstraße, ÖPNV & Supermärkte unter 5 Min. zu Fuß
Ideal für Berufspendler, Expats, Doktorand:innen, Studenten oder alle, die sofort einziehen möchten.

Raumaufteilung

Flur – offener Eingangsbereich, hoher Einbauschrank
Wohn-/Essbereich – Küche + Esstisch, Sofa-Lounge & Arbeitsplatz
Schlafzimmer – Doppelbett, Kommode, großer Spiegel, Verdunkelungsrollos
Bad – Walk-in-Shower, Waschtisch mit LED-Spiegel, Waschmaschine
Sonnenterrasse – perfekte Work-Break-Zone!
Sonstiges / Pflichtangaben

Kaution: 1,5 x Warmmieten
Mindestmietdauer: 6 Monate
Einzug ab: 01.08.2025

Neugierig? Schreib uns kurz etwas zu deiner Person (Beruf, Mietdauer). Wir melden uns schnell für einen Besichtigungstermin!

Lage
Grüne Oase zwischen Spree & Wuhlheide. Bestens angebunden und voller Freizeit­möglichkeiten.

Direkt am grünen Griechischen Park liegt deine neue Wohnung in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße von Berlin-Oberschöneweide (Bezirk Treptow-Köpenick). Hier genießt du entspannte Wohnatmosphäre und bist trotzdem schnell mitten in der Stadt.

Alles vor der Haustür

Spreeufer (500 m) – Sonnenuntergänge am Wasser, Jogging- und Radwege
Spreehöfe – Kino, Bowling & Gastronomie in historischen Backsteinhallen
Reinbeckhallen – wechselnde Kunstausstellungen & Events
Wuhlheide-Park (10 Min. Rad) – Wald, Grillwiesen & das Freizeit- und Erholungszentrum FEZ
HTW Berlin (4 Min. Rad | 13 Min. zu Fuß) & Catalyst Institute (15 Min. Rad) – perfekt für Studierende
Bequem shoppen & besorgen

Wilhelminenhofstraße – Bäcker, Cafés, Apotheken & Drogerien
Mehrere Supermärkte (REWE, EDEKA, Lidl, ALDI) unter 5 Min. zu Fuß
Shopping-Center Schöneweide (2 Tram-Stationen) – Mode, Elektronik, Food-Court
Schnell & flexibel unterwegs

Tramlinien M17 | 21 | 27 | 37 | 60 | 67 – Haltestellen in 4 Min. zu Fuß
S-Bhf. Schöneweide: 6 Min. Tram – Flughafen BER: 20 Min. S-Bahn
Alexanderplatz: 25 Min. ÖPNV
Ring-Bahn (S41/42) ab Ostkreuz – ohne Umstieg in die Szene-Viertel Friedrichshain, Neukölln & Prenzlauer Berg
Kurz gesagt: Ruhig wohnen, am Wasser entspannen, im Park durchatmen – und dank top Tram- & S-Bahn-Anbindung in unter 30 Minuten in Berlins Zentrum oder am Flughafen sein.

Warmmiete inkl. aller Nebenkosten: Strom, Heizung, Warmwasser, High-Speed-Internet sowie Rundfunkbeitrag (GEZ) sind bereits enthalten.

Anmeldung (Wohnsitz) in der Wohnung ist möglich.

Benötigte Unterlagen bei Anfrage

Aktuelle Einkommensnachweise (z. B. Gehaltsabrechnungen, Stipendienbescheid)
Personalausweis oder Reisepass
Nachweis des Umzugsgrundes nach Berlin (z. B. Arbeits-/Ausbildungsvertrag, Studienbescheinigung)
Nach erfolgreicher Prüfung der Unterlagen senden wir den Mietvertrag zur Unterschrift zu.

ALL-INCLUSIVE | Sun-Terrace | Fully Refurbished 2022 | Furnished & Turn-Key | Top-Floor Period Gem

Live above the city rooftops! This light-filled 1-bedroom penthouse apartment (approx. 61 sqm) on the 4th floor of a well-kept historic building combines vintage charm with modern comfort. Just unpack your suitcase—everything is ready!

Highlights at a Glance

All-inclusive rent: utilities, high-speed internet & electricity already covered
Refurbished in 2022: new piping, flooring, bathroom, furniture, etc.
South-facing sun terrace with long-range views
Fully furnished incl. 160 x 200 cm bed, sofa, dedicated workspace, and plenty of storage
Fitted kitchen with induction hob, dishwasher & fridge
Designer bathroom with walk-in rain shower and branded washing machine
Large built-in wardrobe in the hallway for coats & storage
Bicycle parking in the leafy courtyard
Prime location: quiet side street, under 5 min walk to public transport and supermarkets
Ideal for commuters, expats, PhD students, undergrads, or anyone who wants hassle-free living from day one.
Layout

Hallway – open entrance with tall built-in wardrobe
Living / Dining – kitchen, dining table, sofa lounge & workspace
Bedroom – double bed, chest of drawers, large mirror, blackout blinds
Bathroom – walk-in shower, vanity with LED mirror, washing machine
Sun terrace – your perfect work-break zone!
Additional Details

Deposit: 1.5 months all-inclusive rent
Minimum lease: 6 months
Available from: 1 August 2025

Interested? Send us a brief introduction (profession, desired rental period) and we’ll get back to you quickly to arrange a viewing!

Location
Green haven between the River Spree and Wuhlheide Park and perfectly connected with endless leisure options.

Right next to leafy Greek Park, your new apartment sits on a quiet side street in Berlin-Oberschöneweide (Treptow-Köpenick). Enjoy a relaxed neighborhood vibe while staying close to the heart of the city.

Everything at your doorstep

River Spree (500 m) – sunsets on the water, jogging & cycling paths
Spreehöfe – cinema, bowling and dining in historic brick halls
Reinbeckhallen – rotating art exhibitions & cultural events
Wuhlheide Park (10 min by bike) – woodland trails, barbecue lawns & the FEZ leisure centre
HTW Berlin (4 min cycle | 13 min walk) & Catalyst Institute (15 min cycle) – ideal for students
Everyday shopping made easy

Wilhelminenhofstraße – bakeries, cafés, pharmacies & drugstores
Several supermarkets (REWE, EDEKA, Lidl, ALDI) under 5 min walk
Schöneweide Shopping Center (2 tram stops) – fashion, electronics, food court
Fast & flexible transport

Tram lines M17 | 21 | 27 | 37 | 60 | 67 – stops in 4 min on foot
S-Schöneweide station: 6 min by tram – BER Airport: 20 min by S-Bahn
Alexanderplatz: 25 min by public transport
Ringbahn (S41/42) from Ostkreuz – direct to the hot spots of Friedrichshain, Neukölln and Prenzlauer Berg
In short: Live in a quiet setting, relax by the river, breathe in parkland air and, thanks to excellent tram and S-Bahn links, reach downtown Berlin or the airport in under 30 minutes.

All-inclusive rent covers all utilities: electricity, heating, hot water, high-speed internet and the public broadcasting fee (GEZ).

Official registration (Anmeldung) at the address is possible.

Required documents when applying

recent proof of income (e.g. payslips, scholarship letter)
passport or national ID card
proof of your reason for moving to Berlin (e.g. employment or apprenticeship contract, certificate of enrolment)
After we have successfully reviewed your documents, we will send the rental agreement for signature.

title: Deulstraße, Berlin
description:
*ONLY FOR STUDENTS*

Bei der Planung unseres Apartment-Hauses gab es ein großes, übergeordnetes Ziel: 

Das Gebäude muss alles bereithalten und leisten, was du von einem zeitgemäßen und
lebenswerten Zuhause erwartest. Deshalb setzt das Gebäude neue Maßstäbe beim Bau
von Wohnungen. Es übertrifft aktuelle ökologische und energetische Standards, bietet
angesagtes Industrial Design und ist dein Lebensmittelpunkt. Der Neubau ist zudem
technisch erstklassig und sieht gut aus, weil er von einem federführenden Architekten
geplant wurde.

• Hochwertiger Neubau
• Hohe Energieeffizienz und Öko-Standards
• Geringe Nebenkosten
• Modernes Industrial Design
• Ruhige Lage unweit vom Wasser

Dein Zuhause bei uns ist genau so individuell wie du selbst. Alle Apartments beinhalten
volle Möblierung, Schlaf- und Wohnbereich sowie Küche und Duschbad. Sie sind
durchweg hell, flexibel gestaltbar und bis ins letzte Detail durchdacht. Eine kluge
Raumaufteilung, stilvolles Design und Hochtechnologie lassen dabei keine Wünsche
offen.

Waschmaschine (4 Euro pro Nutzung) und Trockner (2 Euro pro Nutzung) befinden sich im Waschsalon. 

GEZ-Gebühren fallen ebenfalls zusätzlich an. 

Die Fotos im Inserat sind Beispielbilder. Die Zimmer können leicht variieren.

The rent for the first month will be paid through HousingAnywhere. The deposit needs to be paid to us directly or via Housing Anywhere payments and should be received before the move-in date, in order to be able to receive the keys.

title: Friedlander Straße, Berlin
description:
This stunning furnished three bedroom apartment features contemporary design, a fully equipped kitchen, and a cozy living area with breathtaking views. Perfectly situated, you'll have easy access to everything that makes Berlin vibrant and exciting!

Treptow is one of Berlin’s hidden gems, offering the perfect balance between nature and city life. Known for its vast green spaces such as Treptower Park and the Spree riverside, the neighborhood is ideal for long walks, jogging, cycling, or simply relaxing by the water.

Despite its peaceful atmosphere, Treptow is very well connected: with quick access to the S-Bahn and Ringbahn, you can reach the lively districts of Kreuzberg, Neukölln, and Mitte within minutes. The area is also home to cozy cafés, local restaurants, and cultural attractions, making it a vibrant yet calm place to live.

Treptow is a great choice for anyone looking to enjoy Berlin’s green side without missing out on the convenience of city living.

title: Wilhelminenhofstraße, Berlin
description:
🌟 XL Sized Private Room for Rent in a Beautiful 5-Bedroom Shared Apartment – Schöneweide, Berlin (12459)

Address: Wilhelminenhofstraße 31, 12459 Berlin – Prime location in Schöneweide

🔑 Property Highlights

Huge XL-Sized Private Room in a spacious and fully furnished 5-bedroom shared apartment

Located on the 1st floor (No elevator)

Shared with 6 friendly housemates – private room + shared kitchen, washroom, and common areas

Fully furnished with essentials:

Bed + bedding set (mattress, pillows, blanket, bedsheets & covers)

Refrigerator, washing machine, oven

WiFi router, vacuum cleaner

Kitchen fully equipped: plates, bowls, cutlery, pots, pans, utensils

Shared furniture: storage racks, tables, chairs

Rental contract in your own name

Anmeldung possible

All bills included (fair-use policy applies)

Broadcasting fee (ARD/ZDF) to be handled by tenants

Minimum rental period: 6 months

Notice period: 2 months (after minimum stay)

No One-time processing fee

Suitable for students and working professionals

No age or gender restrictions

📍 Prime Location: Schöneweide – Beautiful, Convenient, Safe

The apartment is located in Schöneweide, one of Berlin’s most charming and rapidly developing districts. Known for its beautiful riverside paths, excellent public transport, and lively community atmosphere, Schöneweide offers the perfect balance between nature, connectivity and urban comfort.

🚆 Excellent Public Transport Connectivity

Train and bus stops just a few meters from the apartment

Direct and fast connections to:

Berlin Hauptbahnhof (Central Station)

Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER)

Alexanderplatz, Ostkreuz, Warschauer Straße, Zoologischer Garten, and more

Perfect for commuters, students, and anyone needing quick access to all parts of the city

🌳 Beautiful Neighborhood & Lifestyle

Just a few minutes’ walk away, you’ll find:

🌊 Nature & Recreation

Spree River – perfect for walking, jogging, relaxing

Volkspark Wuhlheide – one of Berlin’s largest parks with forests, sports areas, swimming spots, an outdoor stage, and the famous FEZ family center

🎓 Education & Innovation

Close to HTW Berlin (Hochschule für Technik und Wirtschaft) – a major university of applied sciences

Popular with international students and young professionals

🛍️ Shops & Daily Essentials

Multiple supermarkets (LIDL, REWE, ALDI, EDEKA)

Shopping zones, convenience stores, pharmacies, bakeries

Plenty of entertainment options in the surroundings

☕ Cafés & Restaurants

Vibrant food scene with cozy cafés, diverse restaurants, and lively bars

Perfect for working remotely, studying or catching up with friends

🛶 Nearby Attractions

Lakes & water bodies around Köpenick and Treptow

Köpenick Castle, the charming old town of Köpenick

Riverside biking trails, cultural events, markets and more

⭐ Why This Location Is Perfect

Safe, pleasant, and comfortable residential neighborhood

Peaceful environment while still well connected to central Berlin

Ideal for nature lovers, students, professionals and expats

Everything you need within walking distance

Great balance of city convenience + natural beauty + affordability

title: Klettenweg, Berlin
description:
Frei vom 19.04.-22.05.2026 für eine Person.

Herzlich willkommen in unserem 2014 erbauten 1-Zimmer-Apartment! Es befindet sich im 1. OG eines freistehenden Einfamilienhauses in einer ruhigen Gegend im Südosten von Berlin im Bezirk Rudow nahe der Humboldt Universität in Adlershof und nahe dem Flughafen BER und wir freuen uns auf einen neuen Mieter. Unsere vorletzte Mieterin hat 5 Jahre bei uns verbracht und ist aus beruflichen Gründen ausgezogen und unsere letzte Mieterin wurde leider kurzfristig beruflich versetzt. Auch sie wäre sehr gerne länger geblieben. 

Da wir in der Nebenstraße einer Nebenstraße wohnen, ist es hier sehr ruhig. Unsere nächste Bushaltestelle ist 4 Fußminuten entfernt. Von hier gelangen Sie in weiteren 7 Minuten zum U-Bahnhof Rudow. Es fahren die Busse 172 oder 372. In 10 Autominuten sind Sie am Flughafen Schönefeld, Fluglärm ist sehr selten zu hören. Die Stadtautobahn ist in 2-5 Minuten erreichbar und die Humboldt Universität in Adlershof ist mit dem Rad in 10 Minuten erreicht. Am U-Bahnhof stehen auch E-Roller und E-Bikes. Ein Rad können Sie auf Ihre Verantwortung bei uns kostenlos leihen. Ihr eigenes Rad können Sie gerne mitbringen und es findet sich dafür ein Platz.

Über einen separaten Zugang erreichen Sie Ihr ca. 44 m2 großes Domizil. Wir möchten, dass es Ihnen an nichts fehlt. So wurde diese großzügige Wohnung von uns liebevoll und überwiegend hochwertig eingerichtet vom Fön bis zum Rührgerät, Handtücher, Bettwäsche vorhanden, schnelles Internet.

Eine bodentiefe Fensterfront und zwei Oberlichter sorgen für viel Helligkeit. Die Wohnung ist ausgestattet mit Einbauküche (Geschirrspüler, Kühlschrank mit Tiefkühlfach, Elektroherd mit Backofen, Kaffeemaschine, Toaster, Teekocher, Geschirr, Töpfe usw.), Wannenbad mit Akazienvollholzmöbeln, Abstellraum, Fußbodenheizung, Elektrojalousien, Waschtrockner (erneuert), Fernseher, Standventilator. Das sehr hochwertige Schlafsofa der Marke Messina mit enthaltener separater Matratze sorgt für Ihren erholsamen Schlaf (wurde 2023 erneuert). In den beiden Max Winzer Sesseln (wurden 2019 erneuert) lässt sich der Blick in den Himmel genießen oder Sie beobachten die Vögel, Katzen und Eichhörnchen in Garten und Bäumen. In den großen Kleiderschrank passen Ihre Sachen, Palisandertischchen und Esstisch geben der Wohnung eine gemütliche Atmosphäre. Aus der Filmbibliothek können Sie sich gerne Filme ausleihen. Den Garten dürfen Sie gerne mitbenutzen. Ein Stellplatz für Ihr Auto steht Ihnen auf dem Grundstück zur Verfügung. Aufgrund des Interesses meines Sohnes haben wir sehr schnelles Internet.

Im angegebenen Mietpreis pro Monat sind alle Betriebskosten außer Strom enthalten.

Endreinigung 60 € einmalig
Strom 50 €/Monat - Abrechnung nach Zähler

title: Herrenhausstraße, Berlin
description:
Large, bright, modern, newly and comfortably furnished flat with 2 rooms in Berlin-Johannisthal/Adlershof. Minimum rental period 3 months!

Fitted kitchen, bathroom (shower and bathtub), large balcony. Completely renovated and newly furnished. Magnificent view over Berlin to the TV tower. 
The flat is located in the green district Treptow-Köpenick of Berlin, in the district Johannisthal, close to Berlin-Adlershof.

Bright and cosy living room, comfortable double bed couch for 2 persons, modern 80 cm LED TV, ste(hidden)ystem. Internet access, wifi.

The bedroom has a large double bed and a wardrobe, as well as a chest of drawers and an armchair. In the living room there is a comfortable sofa bed (lying surface 1.40 m x 2.00 m). 

Large fully equipped kitchen with window, dining area with bench and 3 chairs in rustic style. Cooker with 4 ceramic hobs, oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, freezer, kettle, toaster, coffee maker, dishes. 

Hallway, kitchen and bathroom are tiled. The other rooms have laminated or carpet flooring. 

The bathroom has a bathtub and a shower, WC, washing machine and a modern sink, mirror, towel radiator. 

No hotel-like services such as bed linen change, towel or cleaning service.

The view from the 12 m2 balcony leads over all surrounding houses to the west up to the TV tower. Sun from about 2pm on the balcony until sunset over Berlin. From all windows you have a wide view into the green and over the roofs.

The flat is on the 6th floor. A modern lift is available.

No traffic noise as the street is a cul-de-sac, used only by residents. 

Conveniently located. Adlershof, Schönefeld, Köpenick, Treptow, Rudow, Neukölln are easily accessible.

In the immediate vicinity (up to a maximum of 10 minutes walk) are 5 supermarkets and many restaurants, a cinema, a post office. The Schöneweide centre (1.6 km away) and Europe's largest shopping centre the "Gropiuspassagen" (4.9 km) invite you to shop and linger.

Berlin's city centre can be reached in 20 minutes via the city motorway or by S-Bahn from Berlin-Schöneweide station. Messe Berlin is 17 minutes away via the city motorway. Berlin Schönefeld Airport is 10 minutes away. The media centre Berlin-Adlershof is 5 minutes away. Bus and tram stops are in the immediate vicinity of the flat.

Arrival via the A113 motorway, exit "Stubenrauchstrasse".

It is a mature residential area with predominantly flat buildings. Quiet location in the south-east of Berlin in the green district of Treptow-Köpenick.

The many lakes and forests in the surrounding area invite you to relax. The "Königsheide" - a large piece of forest of 4 km x 1 km is in the immediate vicinity. The Müggelsee is easy to reach and invites you to swim and do water sports.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore, exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message, and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!

title: Sterndamm, Berlin
description:
Die Wohnung liegt im 3 Stockwerk. Ein moderner Fahrstuhl ist vorhanden. Top Lage im Herzen des grünen und ruhigen Stadtteils Berlin-Johannisthal.  In der unmittelbaren Umgebung (bis maximal 10 Minuten Fußweg) befinden sich 5 Supermärkte und viele Restaurants, ein Kino, eine Post. Das Zentrum Schöneweide (1,1 km entfernt) und Europas größtes Shoppingcenter die "Gropiuspassagen" (4,9 km) laden zum Shoppen und Verweilen ein.

Die Wohnung befindet sich im grünen Stadtbezirk Treptow-Köpenick von Berlin, im Stadtteil Johannisthal, nahe Adlershof (nächster S-Bahnhof ist "Schöneweide").

Zur Berliner Innenstadt gelangen Sie über die Stadtautobahn in 25 Minuten oder per S-Bahn vom Bahnhof Berlin-Schöneweide auch in 25 Minuten. Zur Messe Berlin sind es 20 Minuten über die Stadtautobahn. Zum Flughafen Berlin BER 12 Minuten. Zum Medienstandort Berlin-Adlershof benötigen Sie 5 Minuten. Bushaltestellen und Staßenbahnhaltestelle befinden sich im unmittelbaren Umfeld der Wohnung (100 m).

Es ist eine gewachsene Wohngegend mit überwiegend Mehrfamilienhäusern. Ruhige Lage im Südosten von Berlin im grünen Bezirk Treptow-Köpenick, Stadtteil Berlin-Johannisthal und ganz in der Nähe zum Medien- und Wissenschaftsstandort Berlin-Adlershof.

Die Wohnung ist im Herbst 2021 komplett renoviert, modernisiert und neu eingerichtet worden.

Eine moderne Einbauküche mit allen Geräten (Kühlschrank, Gefrierschrank, Herd, Backofen, Mikrowelle, Kaffeemaschine, Geschirrspühler usw.) und Geschirr ist vorhanden. Im Badezimmer mit Badewanne, Waschbecken und WC  befindet sich auch eine neue Waschmaschine. Der Balkon (zur Südseite) wurde neu mit Holz ausgelegt und auf Stühlen an einem Tisch kann man herrlich entspannen.  Das angrenzende helle gemütliche Wohnzimmer hat einen Essplatz mit Tisch und vier Stühlen. Das Zimmer ist ausgestattet mit einem modernen 80 cm-LED Fernseher, Stereo-Anlage, Blu-ray-Player, WLAN und Internet-Zugang.

Das Schlafzimmer verfügt über ein großes Doppelbett mit Nachtschränken, einen Kleiderschrank, sowie eine Kommode.

Im Kleinen Zimmer / Arbeitszimmer stehen ein Schreibtisch mit Stuhl, eine Doppelbettcouch, Regale und ein Kleiderständer.  Ein Kinderbett und ein Kinderhochstuhl können zur Verfügung gestellt werden.

 Küche und Bad sind gefliest. Die anderen Räume mit Laminat bzw. Teppichboden ausgelegt.

Die Wohnung befindet sich im 3. Stock, daher ganz oben im Haus - ein Fahrstuhl  ist vorhanden.

Join us as our new neighbor in a modern and newly build house and become a part of our warmhearted and welcoming house community.

The apartment has a open-plan kitchen that creates a fluid transition between living, cooking and dining. Further it contains a bedroom, a bathroom, a dressing room and a small storage room. In addition, a large terrace with a beautiful view of the river invites you to linger and relax. 

KÖPENICK
Köpenick, the idyllic suburb in the south-east of Berlin, is a real insider tip for anyone who wants to experience the best of both worlds: the pulsating energy of the capital and the tranquil beauty of nature. Nestled between the Großer Müggelsee lake and the Dahme river (where the flat is located), Köpenick offers an impressive mix of historical sights, green oases and modern comforts. Köpenick is also a safe place to live, as Köpenick is the place in Berlin with the lowest crime rate.

You will immediately be enchanted by the picturesque old town of Köpenick, with its charming cobbled streets, well-preserved half-timbered houses and the impressive Köpenick Palace. This baroque palace, surrounded by a magnificent park, now houses a branch of the Museum of Decorative Arts and offers a fascinating insight into the history and culture of the region.

Köpenick is a paradise for nature lovers. The extensive forests, lakes and rivers invite you to enjoy a wide range of leisure activities. Whether sailing, hiking, cycling, inline skating, swimming, rowing or simply taking a relaxing stroll along the lakeside promenade - here everyone will find the perfect opportunity to escape from everyday life and recharge their batteries.

Despite its tranquil atmosphere, Köpenick has excellent connections to the centre of Berlin. You can reach the capital's famous sights, such as the Brandenburg Gate, Alexanderplatz or Museum Island, in no time at all by S-Bahn or car. After an exciting day in the city, you can return to the peace and comfort of your flat in Köpenick.

From the flat you can quickly reach the airport or the city centre:

BER airport
- 20 minutes by car, taxi, Uber
- 45 minutes by bus or S-Bahn

Adlershof, Berlin
- 10 minutes by car or bike
- 20 minutes by bus or tram

Berlin Central Station
- 45 minutes by car, taxi, Uber
- 60 minutes by S-Bahn and tram
- 130 minutes by boat

Tesla Gigafactory
- 40 minutes by car

Berlin Ostbahnhof
- 30 minutes by car, taxi, Uber
- 45 minutes by bus and S-Bahn
- 90 minutes by boat

Union Berlin, Alte Försterei (our football club)
- 10 minutes by bike
- 30 minutes on foot

Köpenick old town
- 5 minutes by bike
- 15 minutes on foot

Lidl, supermarket
- 1 minute by bike
- 4 minutes on foot

Culinary delights are not neglected in Köpenick either. A variety of restaurants, cafés and beer gardens offer delicacies from all over the world, often with a distinctive regional touch. Try fresh fish from the surrounding waters or enjoy a hearty German beer in one of the traditional pubs.

Köpenick is more than just a suburb - it's a way of life. A place where history meets modernity, nature meets urbanity and tranquillity meets vibrancy. A place that offers both families and individuals an unrivalled quality of life. Let yourself be enchanted by Köpenick and experience Berlin at its best. Welcome to your new home!

The residential area is located on the banks of the Spree River in Berlin's Köpenick district, in the southeast of the city. Köpenick is the largest and most sparsely populated district in Berlin. The Köpenick Forest is the largest forest area, and nature can also be enjoyed in numerous parks and green spaces. Spindlersfeld boasts excellent transport links, a comprehensive educational landscape, and numerous modern healthcare facilities. Last but not least, Köpenick's old town, with its nightlife and diverse cultural offerings, makes the Spreequartier an attractive place to live.

IN 30 MINUTES IN THE CENTER OF BERLIN

One of Spindlersfeld's great advantages is its excellent public transport connections. The S-Bahn (suburban train) provides a quick connection to the center of Berlin. For example, it takes about 30 minutes to get to Berlin Alexanderplatz by S-Bahn. Two tram lines lead to Köpenick and Rahnsdorf, to the Adlershof Science City, and to the Johannisthal Landscape Park.

A good infrastructure and promising technology locations in the surrounding area

There are several large grocery supermarkets in the immediate vicinity. For shopping and strolling in Köpenick, it's just two tram stops away. A newly built daycare center is located nearby.

The new Adlershof Science Park is just around the corner. It is one of the 15 largest science parks in the world. It is the most important scientific and business location in Berlin-Brandenburg. Spanning an area of ​​4.2 km2, it is home to renowned non-university research institutions, the mathematics and natural sciences campus of the Humboldt University of Berlin, and over 1,200 companies and institutions with more than 23,000 employees.

There are many opportunities to organize your leisure activities. Either you can relax and unwind with extensive park and

Relax on forest walks or go hiking, jogging, or cycling. Since the Dahme, Spree, and Müggelsee rivers are also nearby, there are many water sports opportunities for leisure activities.
